blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese academic on Monday suggested allowing Chinese boats to fish inside the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone in exchange for a fee, proposing a permit system as a potential compromise in the South China Sea dispute between Manila and Beijing. Shen Dingli, a member of the academic committee at the Beijing-based Grandview Institution, said his proposal was intended as a compromise to find middle ground, pointing to China’s large population and food needs. “I may offend my government by proposing the following idea without consulting with my government,” he said at the Manila Dialogue on the South China […]...
